title: auth.resolve_merged_user
description: Where did this user id go? Reads the merge ledger and returns the account the id is reachable as today, following the whole chain rather than one hop. Returns {user_id, merged, merged_at, source}; an id that was never merged comes back unchanged with merged=false, so this is safe to call on every id a consumer holds.

user_id.description: A user id a consumer still holds. May or may not have been merged away.
